columns.name: APP_DRAFT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the application draft. System generated value.

columns.name: DRAFT_SOURCE
columns.description: Indicates the source of draft data

columns.name: LAST_ACCESSED_ON
columns.description: Last user agent used by user to access application draft

columns.name: LEGAL_DESC_VERSION_ID
columns.description: LEGAL_DESCRIPTION_VERSION_ID to save legal description id in rest

columns.name: SITE_NUMBER
columns.description: Foreign key to the IRC_CX_SITES_B table.

columns.name: OBJECT_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates the status of the object

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUISITION_NUMBER
columns.description: Requisition number used to identify application draft requisition.

columns.name: PHONE_NUMBER
columns.description: Telephone number. Not marked as mandatory in order to always allow creation of a first phone row for every person even when phone number is not provided.

columns.name: EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Candidate email address used to identify candidate.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country code of the Phone Number.

columns.name: AREA_CODE
columns.description: The Area Code of the Phone Number.

columns.name: CONTENT
columns.description: JSON payload with the application draft.

columns.name: CANDIDATE_NUMBER
columns.description: Candidate Number used to get last modified date from Candidates

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_JOB_EXECUTION_DATE
columns.description: Last execution date of the ESS job needed for idempotency.

columns.name: CONTENT_LANGUAGE
columns.description: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: PROPOSED_CAND_NUM
columns.description: Candidate number of the candidate who does not have entry in IRC_CANDIDATES. Needed for Inline Assessments.

columns.name: PREFERRED_CHANNEL
columns.description: Preferred Communication channel for the candidate. It can be E-mail, phone or something else.

columns.name: MODIFICATION_DATE
columns.description: Date of modification of the record done by the draft REST Service it is not the same as LAST_UPDATE_DATE as we don't want it to be updated every time row is changed.

columns.name: JOB_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the row after ESS job was executed it is enumeration of different statuses for example ORA_INVALID, ORA_FIRST_NOTIF_SENT.

columns.name: APPLY_FLOW_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the Request Information Flow. Reference to the IRC_APPLY_FLOWS_B table.

columns.name: SUBMISSION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the Submission on which Request Information Flow is needed. Reference to the IRC_JA_SECONDARY_FLOWS table.

columns.name: STEP_ACTION_USAGE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the Request Information Flow Action Id. Reference to the IRC_JA_SECONDARY_FLOWS table.

columns.name: EXTRA_INFO1
columns.description: Attribute to store additional information.

columns.description: Attribute to store additional information.

columns.description: Attribute to store additional information.

columns.description: Attribute to store additional information.
